about: WPCS security findings on the shipped verifier's src/, reviewed by Maurice on 2026-09-26 (notes/m5-packaging.md); src/Cli no longer ships since 2026-09-27 (SPEC-006 amendment 4); reviewed again for v0.2.4 on 2026-09-27 (SPEC-006 amendment 5: eight ExceptionNotEscaped findings in two new exception messages) and for v0.2.5 the same day (SPEC-006 amendment 7: five more, in four new exception messages), for v0.2.6 on 2026-09-28 (SPEC-006 amendment 8: one more base64_decode, a public key read as DER), for v0.2.7 on 2026-09-30 (SPEC-006 amendment 9: fread 6 to 2, the reads now go through one helper), and for v0.2.8 the same day (SPEC-006 amendment 10: thirteen more ExceptionNotEscaped, in six new exception messages in Hash/BmffHashCheck.php), and for v0.2.9 on 2026-10-02 (src/ byte for byte v0.2.8's, so the counts stand), and for v0.3.0 on 2026-10-05 (SPEC-006 amendment 11: 61 more ExceptionNotEscaped, in the new RIFF and ID3 readers and the RSA-PSS key rewrite, and one more base64_encode, a public key built as PEM), and for v0.4.0 on 2026-10-06 (SPEC-006 amendment 12: 26 more ExceptionNotEscaped, 23 in the new GIF reader and one each where four readers rethrow with withStoreReached(), one fewer in the RIFF reader), and for v0.5.0 on 2026-10-07 (SPEC-006 amendment 13: 23 more ExceptionNotEscaped and two more fread, all in the new plain-text reader). For v0.5.3 on 2026-10-09 (SPEC-006 amendment 16): one more ExceptionNotEscaped, the Requestable message in Jumbf/JumbfParser.php, whose only value is the box's offset as an integer. The release test fails on a new sniff or a higher count. Update only after a review, with the verifier version. For v0.6.0 on 2026-10-09 (SPEC-006 amendment 17): nine more ExceptionNotEscaped, four in the plain-text reader's new messages (integers only) and five in the two new manifest-label refusals (the label from the file; the plugin never shows a verifier message). For v0.7.0 on 2026-10-13 (SPEC-006 amendment 19): fifteen more ExceptionNotEscaped, twelve in the new JPEG segment walk (Hash/JpegExclusionAllowance.php: offsets, lengths and marker bytes as integers or hex only), two in StreamReader::seek() (an offset and a fixed noun), and one in BmffHashCheck's refused-exclusion message (the xpath from the file); the plugin keeps only failure codes and never shows a verifier message. For v0.7.1 on 2026-10-22 (SPEC-006 amendment 20): one file changed, no new message; the counts stand. For v0.8.0 on 2026-10-23 (SPEC-006 amendment 21, reviewed by Maurice): two json_encode (CrJsonValue::fromJson's probe, VerificationReport::toCrJson), two serialize (CrJsonValue::fromJson compares two decodings; nothing is unserialized), two base64_encode (crJSON's b64'...' values in CrJsonValue and CrJsonDocument), one base64_decode (a LoTE list's certificates in TrustSettings), and 27 ExceptionNotEscaped (12 in CrJsonValue, 15 in TrustSettings' LoTE reader); all in code the plugin never calls (toCrJson, fromTrustLists), and the plugin never shows a verifier message; and for v0.8.1 on 2026-10-24 (SPEC-006 amendment 22: four files changed, the counts stand); and for v0.8.2 on 2026-10-25 (SPEC-006 amendment 23): six more ExceptionNotEscaped, all in the one new message of Cose/SignatureVerifier.php::requireFit() that refuses an ECDSA key on another curve (the algorithm name, its number, the key kind and curve from PublicKey::describe(), and a fixed curve name); the plugin keeps only failure codes and never shows a verifier message.
